name: veo
description: Generate videos using Google Veo 3.1 on Vertex AI. Defaults to the GA Veo 3.1 Fast model (veo-3.1-fast-generate-001); the premium Veo 3.1 and the cheaper Veo 3.1 Lite (Preview) models are opt-in via --pro/--lite. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video (first/last frame), 16:9 / 9:16, 720p/1080p (4k on Pro), 4-8s clips, and 1-4 videos per request. Requires Vertex AI.
